destination.title: Warped compactifications: hierarchies, effective dynamics and cosmology
destination.question: How does warping affect scale hierarchies, lower-dimensional dynamics and the consistency of compactifications and their cosmological applications?
destination.summary: A navigational family containing distinct construction, stabilization, kinetic, spectral and cosmological questions. Its systems, dimensions, supersymmetry assumptions and methods remain source-specific.

systems: Warped string compactifications and local throats
Type IIB/F-theory settings and the supplied type IIA alternatives
Warped M-theory reductions to three dimensions
Smooth compact source-free type II cosmologies
targets: Moduli actions, stabilization and truncation control
regimes: Strong warping and explicitly identified weak-warping comparisons
Static and evolving backgrounds kept distinct
Classical, two-derivative and quantum-corrected analyses at their stated orders
assumptions: No universal stabilization, supersymmetry, dimension or scale-separation premise
Local throat construction does not establish a globally controlled compactification
conventions: Flux labels, volume variables and metric normalizations remain source-specific
Graph relations describe source objects and do not automatically constrain every question facet
includes: Construction, method, comparison and application contributions
excludes: A claim that numerical proximity establishes scientific equivalence
Automatic inclusion of every conifold or flux-deformation question in the warped core
Universal de Sitter, stability or observational conclusions

sources.title: Mass Hierarchies and Dynamical Field Range

evidence.text: Can warping or loop-generated mass scales produce the heavy-to-light hierarchy needed for a reliable extended dynamical range while respecting flux quantization? Can the toroidal conclusions be retained when the kinetic geometry comes from a generic Calabi-Yau compactification?

sources.title: Thraxions: Ultralight Throat Axions

evidence.text: Can homologically related warped throats produce an axion parametrically lighter than throat KK modes after geometric backreaction, and what do its finite monodromy and potential imply for large field ranges and the axionic WGC?

sources.title: Conifold dynamics and axion monodromies

evidence.text: Does conifold-modulus stability obstruct parametrically super-Planckian axion-monodromy excursions generated by repeated brane-flux transitions in warped throats?

sources.title: Cheeger bounds on spin-two fields

evidence.text: Which energy and warp-gradient assumptions give geometric control over the spin-two spectrum of a warped compactification?

sources.title: LVS de Sitter vacua are probably in the swampland

evidence.text: Can a flux-supported throat generate large bulk curvature despite an apparently large compactification volume? The relevant comparison includes its D3 charge KM, because flux-sourced gradients grow with charge.

sources.title: Toward an effective theory of the volume modulus

evidence.text: How do strong warping and D7-brane gaugino condensation affect the profile and mass of the warped volume modulus, and can its mass separate parametrically from the four-dimensional AdS curvature scale?

sources.title: Big Crunching Your Big Bang: Doubly Warped Time-Dependent Type II Flux Backgrounds and Scale Separation

evidence.text: Can smooth compact source-free type II backgrounds support nonconstant internal warping together with cosmological evolution, and do their four-dimensional cosmologies exhibit a controlled hierarchy from KK modes or preserve supersymmetry?

sources.title: Hierarchies from fluxes in string compactifications

evidence.text: Can a compact string background contain a Klebanov–Strassler-type warped region with finite four-dimensional Planck scale and a large finite hierarchy determined by quantized fluxes? Which moduli can be fixed within the classical approximation?

sources.title: Holographic dual of the standard model on the throat

evidence.text: Can flux-supported warped throats retain terminal singularities supporting a three-family SM-like sector, with an explicit cascading holographic dual? Can successive complex deformations generate several radial hierarchy scales?

sources.title: Dynamics of warped compactifications and the shape of the warped landscape

evidence.text: How do warping, moduli dynamics, nonperturbative effects and mobile branes determine four-dimensional potentials, and what conditions permit controlled moduli stabilization, de Sitter extrema and slow-roll inflation?

sources.title: Structures in the Gauge/Gravity Duality Cascade

evidence.text: Can rank-dependent corrections to anomalous dimensions in the Klebanov–Strassler cascade produce identifiable structures in the dual fluxes, geometry and D3-brane inflationary action?

sources.title: Mass Hierarchies and Dynamical Field Range

evidence.text: Find potential minima numerically at displaced axion values, determine the saxion responses, and integrate the induced kinetic coefficient. Compare the added saxion term with the projected term to locate the tolerance crossing.

sources.title: Thraxions: Ultralight Throat Axions

evidence.text: A proposed 4d supergravity completion is evaluated by solving the local deformation F-terms and integrating out zi. Independently within the paper, the KS gauge-theory dictionary and infrared gaugino condensation provide a matching effective superpotential.

sources.title: Conifold dynamics and axion monodromies

evidence.text: Combine the flux-induced conifold F-term potential with the polarized NS5 probe potential, whose Z-dependence enters through warping. Locate simultaneous extrema and impose positivity of the radicand determining the conifold minimum.

sources.title: Cheeger bounds on spin-two fields

evidence.text: Extend eigenvalue inequalities through Rayleigh min-max principles, Lipschitz approximation, coarea inequalities and heat-semigroup arguments; analyze surface examples using magnetic Schrödinger and Legendre equations.

sources.title: LVS de Sitter vacua are probably in the swampland

evidence.text: Specialize general vev and mass expressions to the stated AdS setup, omit prescribed terms and remove uplift. Inspect surviving corrections rather than assuming that removing uplift restores control.

sources.title: Toward an effective theory of the volume modulus

evidence.text: Solve simplified radial models: a weakly warped large-volume region, an AdS5 × T^{1,1} throat, and a throat joined to a bulk. Local condensate physics is represented by Neumann boundary data and, where applicable, matching conditions.

sources.title: Scales and hierarchies in warped compactifications and brane worlds

evidence.text: How do four-dimensional thresholds in warped brane compactifications depend on geometry versus supersymmetry-breaking dynamics, and can flux compactifications combine a warped hierarchy, heavy bulk fields, and light visible matter?

sources.title: Swampland Variations on a Theme by KKLT

evidence.text: Can flux stabilization near a conifold produce a warped compactification whose conifold and Kähler moduli admit a consistent four-dimensional effective description?

sources.title: The Universal Kahler Modulus in Warped Compactifications

evidence.text: What are the correct spacetime-dependent ten-dimensional wavefunctions and four-dimensional kinetic theory of the universal Kähler modulus and its axion in warped compactifications, including strong warping and finite modulus motion?

sources.title: Warping the Kähler potential of F-theory/IIB flux compactifications

evidence.text: How does nonconstant warping determine the low-energy Kähler potential, holomorphic coordinates and kinetic terms of F-theory/IIB flux compactifications, including Kähler, universal, mobile-D3 and axionic moduli?

sources.title: The effective action of warped M-theory reductions with higher derivative terms — part I

evidence.text: Determine the three-dimensional two-derivative action for Kähler metric deformations and three-form vector modes in warped M-theory compactifications, including higher-curvature corrections and the deformation dependence of the warp factor.

sources.title: Dynamics of Warped Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: How can type IIB compactification yield a four-dimensional effective action that includes strong warping, moduli and light KK excitations, while respecting ten-dimensional constraint equations?

sources.title: KKLT and the Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can the conifold and volume fields be described reliably when a long, strongly warped throat develops?

sources.title: Sequestered Conformal Anomaly Mediation (SCAM)

evidence.text: When does sequestered anomaly mediation derived in stabilized 5d supergravity reproduce the usual 4d prediction, and how do warping, boundary superpotentials and radion dynamics modify the required effective theory?

sources.title: The Tension between 10D Supergravity and dS Uplifts

evidence.text: How are volume, warping, fluxes and external curvature normalized? The single Kähler modulus is ρ=θ+iσ with σ=L⁴. The curvature analysis uses a metric parametrization without the explicit volume factors displayed in the dimensional-reduction review.

sources.title: The Ubiquitous throat

evidence.text: How common are strongly warped Klebanov–Strassler throats, and what are their number and hierarchy distributions, in the KKLT branch of the type IIB landscape with realistically small positive cosmological constant?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Can a long warped direction coexist with a string-sized internal space and heavy charged strings?

sources.title: Stable Non-Supersymmetric Throats in String Theory

evidence.text: Can explicitly non-supersymmetric warped throats support a large hierarchy without UV-generated relevant perturbations prematurely ending the throat, including after compactification and coupling to four-dimensional gravity?

sources.title: Stringy effects during inflation and reheating

evidence.text: Can strongly warped sectors in multi-throat string compactifications coexist with high-scale inflation, and can their string/KK physics affect inflationary fluctuations and Standard Model reheating?

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: The mobile D3 position provides the inflaton candidate in a warped throat. Warping suppresses the anti-D3 energy, while conifold geometry supplies calculable radial and angular dependence for forces induced by moduli stabilization.

sources.title: Warped Supersymmetry Breaking

evidence.text: How does strong warping suppress supersymmetry breaking seen by matter deep in a throat, and under what scale hierarchies can that physics admit a 4D supergravity description, possibly supplemented by soft terms?

sources.title: Warped spectroscopy: Localization of frozen bulk modes

evidence.text: How does warping change the wavefunction, mass and effective-theory status of flux-stabilized dilaton–axion modes, including corrections from coupled supergravity fluctuations?

sources.title: Kinetic terms in warped compactifications

evidence.text: How should kinetic terms of compactification moduli be computed with warping and gauge constraints, and what does the resulting prescription imply for the complex deformation modulus of a warped conifold?

sources.title: The dark dimension in a warped throat

evidence.text: Can a strongly warped string throat realize the dark dimension and m ∼ Λ^(1/4), while keeping other towers and moduli compatible with astrophysical constraints?

sources.title: Warp factor and the gravitational wave spectrum

evidence.text: How does the complete Dp/Op-sourced warp factor change the four-dimensional gravitational-wave Kaluza–Klein spectrum relative to a constant-warp torus, after excluding the unphysical negative-warp region?

sources.title: On axion monodromy inflation in warped throats

evidence.text: Can flux-supported warped throats suppress the axion-inflaton scale relative to bulk moduli-stabilization physics while retaining monodromy over super-Planckian excursions, and what geometric and gauge-theory structures realize this?

sources.title: Dimensional reduction and Kähler metric for metric moduli in imaginary self-dual flux

evidence.text: What four-dimensional kinetic action and moduli-space metric follow directly from ten-dimensional equations for geometric Kähler moduli and unstabilized complex-structure/axiodilaton directions in warped ISD-flux compactifications?

sources.title: Warping and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can warping turn the high energy associated with an antibrane flux dual into a hierarchically small supersymmetry-breaking scale while maintaining a controlled, stabilized compactification?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: How should anomaly-canceling form interactions be interpreted when the warped metric and flux background vary in time?

sources.title: Realistic D-brane models on warped throats: Fluxes, hierarchies and moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Can semirealistic chiral D-brane sectors be placed at a flux-generated warped throat tip, realizing the electroweak/Planck hierarchy while providing mechanisms for moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Quantum Log-Corrections to Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can a strongly warped throat generate exponentially small W0 with a better controlled light tower than the toroidal construction?

sources.title: Uplifting Runaways

evidence.text: A warped throat must retain its conifold deformation while supplying a small uplift. In a compact embedding, fluxes and the ultraviolet gluing surface make deformation changes physical, rather than removable solely by rescaling noncompact coordinates.

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can a warped string compactification support positive four-dimensional curvature with controlled quantum corrections? The paper asks whether external deformations suffice or whether internal geometry and fluxes must also evolve.

destination.title: Scalar distance, light spectra and gravitational limits
destination.question: How do scalar-field distance, quantum geometry and proposed extensions of distance organize light spectra, effective descriptions and gravitational limits?
destination.summary: This is a navigation family spanning several physical questions. Numerical proximity does not establish equivalence, a common conjectural premise, or a universal inference from infinite distance. Geometry, potential dynamics, brane spectra, duality reconstruction and spacetime admissibility retain their own assumptions.

systems: Gravitational scalar EFTs and string compactifications
Moduli spaces, including quantum-corrected and locally symmetric examples
Associated brane, cosmological, defect and holographic settings
targets: Distance limits, light towers and EFT validity
Metric emergence and quantum obstruction of classical limits
Asymptotic potentials and proposed dynamical distances
Brane charges, tensions, extremality and dual descriptions
regimes: Finite regions when testing onset or alternative refinements
Potential-driven trajectories and spacetime configurations, separately qualified
assumptions: Conjectures and conditional calculations are retained as such
Source-specific supersymmetry, compactifiability, spectral and control assumptions are not family-wide premises
conventions: Endpoint geodesic distance, trajectory length and proposed generalized distances remain distinct
Relative mass suppression is distinguished from an absolute sub-Planckian scale
Graph relations describe source objects and do not automatically constrain physical-question facets
includes: Ordinary geometric and EFT work without requiring a Swampland formulation
Boundary comparisons and explicit alternate homes
Source-scoped access to compound questions pending reconciliation
excludes: Treating numerical membership as scientific equivalence
Localized-current regularization as a distance question without further evidence
A universal de Sitter exclusion, emergence theorem or duality derivation

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Do infinite-distance Kähler-moduli limits admit exponentially light physical towers, and can quantum corrections from those towers generate the divergent scalar metric?

sources.title: Swampland Distance Conjecture for One-Parameter Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: These compactifications allow period geometry to determine scalar distances and BPS central charges, providing explicit geometric tests of the distance conjecture.

sources.title: The web of swampland conjectures and the TCC bound

evidence.text: Which scalar potentials and infinite-distance limits can occur in low-energy theories descending from string theory? The common language is Einstein gravity with scalar field-space metric g_ij, potential V, and geodesic distance D.

sources.title: Merging the weak gravity and distance conjectures using BPS extremal black holes

evidence.text: How do BPS particles and black-hole extremality behave near infinite distance in a moduli space with several gauge and scalar fields?

sources.title: Non-BPS path to the string lamppost

evidence.text: Can Swampland consistency conditions recover the emergent description, gauge-enhancement loci, and nonperturbative brane physics of 9d supergravity limits without assuming a string-theory UV origin, thereby supporting the String Lamppost Principle?

sources.title: Running decompactification, sliding towers, and the distance conjecture

evidence.text: Do warped decompactification limits with a running dilaton satisfy the sharpened Distance Conjecture, the Emergent String Conjecture and the Convex Hull Scalar Weak Gravity Conjecture when non-BPS tower masses vary nontrivially over moduli space?

sources.title: Gravity decoupling and axionic shift symmetries

evidence.text: How do approximate axionic shift symmetries and gradients of BPS string tensions and particle masses characterise gravity decoupling, kinetic mixing and curvature divergences in asymptotic moduli-space limits?

sources.title: Emergent Strings at an Infinite Distance with Broken Supersymmetry

evidence.text: Do the endpoints of an unstable flux-vacuum cascade with broken supersymmetry lie at generalized infinite distance, and do KK or emergent-string towers become exponentially light there?

sources.title: Tensionless string limits in 4d conformal manifolds

evidence.text: How are overall-free infinite-distance limits of large-N 4d SCFTs classified by higher-spin decay rates and densities of states, what tensionless strings might describe them, and what do their towers imply for AdS scale separation?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Bound the norm of dK, apply Cauchy–Schwarz to the path velocity, and integrate its total variation. The operation avoids geodesic solutions and supplies a lower bound for paths within the controlled metric region.

sources.title: Swampland Distance Conjecture for One-Parameter Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: Given a proposed BPS decay, sum its complex central charges and compare the initial mass with the sum of daughter masses. Nonalignment excludes the channel. Alignment locates a possible marginal-stability wall but still requires quantized charges and actual daughter states.

sources.title: The web of swampland conjectures and the TCC bound

evidence.text: Match each sector with its Hodge-dual complement, retain metric-dependent weights, and combine equal norm contributions. In the radius split, exchange zero-leg and one-leg sectors.

sources.title: Merging the weak gravity and distance conjectures using BPS extremal black holes

evidence.text: Normalize fields, isolate a common-exponent charge sector, evaluate the dilatonic bound, and project the resulting logarithmic mass gradient onto the selected geodesic. Keep the charge frame and fixed discrete labels explicit.

sources.title: Emergent Strings at an Infinite Distance with Broken Supersymmetry

evidence.text: RG-flow lengths use the connected-correlator information metric g_ab = ∫d^d x ⟨O_a(x)O_b(0)⟩ and an Anselmi metric evaluated at an inverse-energy-scale separation. They agree up to a constant in this calculation, while differing generally; volume factors and coupling coordinates matter.

sources.title: Non-BPS path to the string lamppost

evidence.text: Analyze asymptotic global geodesics as boosts acting on the charge lattice. Null boost lines identify candidate light charges; BPS completeness and the mild WGC are then used to argue that lattice points on these lines support BPS states.

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture and Towers of Tensionless Branes

evidence.text: Do infinite-distance limits supporting the particle Swampland Distance Conjecture also produce tensionless strings and domain walls, and how do their towers and energy scales depend on the direction through moduli space?

sources.title: Axion-scalar systems and dynamical distances

evidence.text: Can physical, non-geodesic axion–saxion trajectories acquire parametrically greater length than endpoint geodesic distances, undermining an extension of the Distance Conjecture to cosmological evolution? Which late-time solutions and string-derived potentials permit this?

sources.title: Instantons and infinite distances

evidence.text: Can instanton corrections remove a distance divergence in a classical moduli-space metric? The appendix addresses this in a mirror IIA construction by comparing its corrected leading metric with the earlier IIB analysis.

sources.title: On Quantum Obstructions in Type IIA Orientifolds

evidence.text: Do classical infinite-distance limits involving only Type IIA orientifold Kähler moduli survive quantum corrections when the four-dimensional dilaton and complex-structure-sector moduli remain finite? The paper also asks whether an obstruction removes the limit entirely or merely invalidates its perturbative description.

sources.title: Dualities from Swampland principles

evidence.text: Under which assumptions can Swampland principles, especially the sharpened distance conjecture, explain the duality web of supersymmetric theories in d ≥ 9?

sources.title: On measuring distances in the quantum gravity landscape

evidence.text: How can moduli-space distance be extended to scalar configurations separated by a potential, including gravitational backreaction, using normalized domain-wall tension or Euclidean action? Can this recover the logarithmic AdS distance and inform a potential-dependent Distance Conjecture?

sources.title: Topology change and non-geometry at infinite distance

evidence.text: How does the Swampland Distance Conjecture survive topology-changing and non-geometric T-dualities when curvature, torsion or flux obstruct momentum/winding towers expected at infinite field distance?

sources.title: Asymptotic accelerated expansion in string theory and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can an infinite-distance string limit produce accelerated expansion while corrections remain parametrically suppressed and all relevant moduli are consistently treated?

sources.title: Taxonomy of Potentials in Asymptotic Limits

evidence.text: Can the exponential moduli-dependence of scalar-potential terms in generic infinite-distance limits be classified discretely, extending particle/brane taxonomy, and can that classification imply asymptotic de Sitter and species-scale bounds?

sources.title: The swampland at large number of space-time dimensions

evidence.text: Can the mass proxy be replaced by genuine geometric distance across dimensions, and can LDC be tested with controlled curvature corrections? Whether it explains string critical dimensions also remains open.

sources.title: Infinite Distances and the Axion Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Which wrapped-brane states can realize the tower predicted near infinite geodesic distance? The paper imports the distance-conjecture motivation and repurposes the candidate three-cycle charges for an axion-instanton analysis.

sources.title: Revisiting the refined Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Does the refined Distance Conjecture constrain low-energy physics in finite regions of moduli space, and can alternative refinements impose absolute bounds on tower masses rather than merely relative exponential suppression?

sources.title: Stress-Testing Swampland Bounds with Class S Theories

evidence.text: Do the CFT Sharpened Distance Conjecture (SharpDC) and the AdS Refined Distance Conjecture (RDC) survive tests using supersymmetric gauge theories and Class S theories? In particular, is large central charge sufficient for SharpDC, and does RDC constrain the genus dependence of Weil–Petersson diameter?

sources.title: Swampland and the Geometry of Marked Moduli Spaces

evidence.text: Can contractibility and uniqueness of physical shortest paths on marked moduli spaces replace asymptotic negative-curvature conjectures, including near positive-curvature divergences and finite-distance QFT singularities?

sources.title: Geodesic gradient flows in moduli space

evidence.text: When do moduli-dependent brane tensions or particle masses generate geodesics through their logarithmic gradient flows, and when can this local spectral information identify trajectories approaching infinite-distance limits?

sources.title: Reconstructing string dualities through symmetries of moduli spaces

evidence.text: How far can moduli-space symmetries and the Emergent String Conjecture reconstruct the dual perturbative descriptions at infinite distance, including strong-coupling limits, from a known weakly coupled description?

sources.title: Weak gravity bounds in asymptotic string compactifications

evidence.text: How does graviphoton charge selection depend on the moduli subsector when the enhancement chain has separate II, III, and IV steps? Each lowering operator is stated to act once, and Table B.8 displays eight descendant combinations.

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: How can an EFT fail near a moduli-space boundary when its leading metric remains accurate? The caption distinguishes ordinary corrections that limit a local patch from a tower-induced quantum-gravity cutoff that falls toward an infinite-distance singularity.

sources.title: Moduli Space Quantum Mechanics

evidence.text: How do infinite-distance taxonomy relations constrain commutators in moduli-space quantum mechanics, and can moduli-space geometry produce normalizable excited states localized away from classical runaway limits?

sources.title: The Boundary of Symmetric Moduli Spaces and the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: When do compactifiability and assumptions on the spectrum imply the Swampland Distance Conjecture (SDC) for locally symmetric moduli spaces, and how do Lie-group weights determine leading towers and their decay rates?

sources.title: Infinite Distance Limits and Information Theory

evidence.text: Can a distinguishability interpretation explain the infinite-distance behavior postulated for quantum-gravity moduli spaces?

sources.title: No Shortcuts to Infinity: Weil-Petersson Distance in Calabi-Yau Complex Structure Moduli Space

evidence.text: When is a boundary point at infinite Weil–Petersson distance, including intersections of arbitrary codimension? Can any trajectory with changing saxion hierarchies or unrestricted axion winding provide a finite-length shortcut?

sources.title: Revisiting Dudas-Mourad Compactifications

evidence.text: How do Dudas–Mourad interval compactifications generalize with dimension and exponential-potential slope, which fields survive reduction, and do the resulting spectra resolve the moduli problem while exhibiting distance-conjecture behavior?

sources.title: Lectures on the Swampland Program in String Compactifications

evidence.text: How do BPS protection, extremality and no force differ, and how could compactification geometry test the sharpening?

sources.title: Tackling the SDC in AdS with CFTs

evidence.text: How do distance limits behave with twisted-sector moduli beyond the axio-dilaton? The ZK orbifold provides several marginal couplings and a known necklace-quiver description.

sources.title: Moduli Stabilisation and the Holographic Swampland

evidence.text: Does a large geodesic displacement in moduli space require an exponentially light tower? The reviewed distinction is between an asymptotic prediction and onset already at distances of order M_P, with an order-one exponential coefficient.

sources.title: Asymptotic curvature divergences and non-gravitational theories

evidence.text: What causes positive scalar-curvature divergences along infinite-distance large-volume limits, and can their growth identify the higher-dimensional non-gravitational UV theory underlying a decoupled four-dimensional rigid sector?

sources.title: On the correspondence between black holes, domain walls and fluxes

evidence.text: Can a supergravity dictionary between BPS black holes, domain walls and type IIA flux vacua motivate potential-based swampland conjectures, particularly reconcile the AdS distance conjecture (ADC) with the black hole entropy distance conjecture (BHEDC)?

sources.title: Finiteness and the emergence of dualities

evidence.text: Can finiteness of fully compactified quantum gravity constrain moduli-space volume growth strongly enough to require nontrivial dualities and semisimple actions on charges?

sources.title: Transplanckian Censorship and the Local Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can an excitation at fixed asymptotic moduli sample an arbitrarily large field-space distance within a controlled local EFT? The proposed obstructions concern the excitation's stability, enclosing size, gravitational geometry, and the resolution required to observe its largest excursion.

sources.title: Tackling the SDC in AdS with CFTs

evidence.text: Can classically finite axionic motion yield infinite quantum distance at fixed axio-dilaton? Vanishing twisted periods produce original-frame strong coupling and motivate a duality-frame change.

sources.title: A distance conjecture beyond moduli?

evidence.text: How might the distance conjecture be extended from moduli spaces to asymptotic scalar trajectories with a potential, and what would such an extension imply for cosmological EFT breakdown and ekpyrosis?

sources.title: On asymptotic dark energy in string theory

evidence.text: Can competing terms in asymptotic scalar potentials realize accelerated expansion in explicit string compactifications without Kähler moduli? Separately, can including interacting massive towers connect the Strong Asymptotic dS Conjecture to the Sharpened Distance Conjecture?

sources.title: Dynamical Cobordism and Swampland Distance Conjectures

evidence.text: In solutions driven by dynamical scalar tadpoles, does field-space distance distinguish spacetime-ending walls of nothing from interpolating domain walls, and how does the SDC scale relate to spacetime distance and curvature?

sources.title: The Asymptotic dS Swampland Conjecture ‐ a Simplified Derivation and a Potential Loophole

evidence.text: What restrictions on scalar potentials follow near an infinite-distance boundary of field space, where string-theory control is expected to improve parametrically? The paper addresses this asymptotic question rather than a conjecture imposed throughout moduli space.

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: If a tower generates the asymptotic moduli-space metric, should it also explain the discrete geometric data that determine that metric?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Can the distance conjecture quantify the obstruction to restoring ordinary or generalized global symmetries, and can charges under the associated discrete duality select the relevant light degrees of freedom?

sources.title: Axion-scalar Dynamics: from the Distance Conjecture to Cosmic Acceleration

evidence.text: Does replacing geodesic distance by cosmological trajectory length preserve a dynamical extension of the Distance Conjecture in one-modulus asymptotic limits, and can axion–saxion dynamics near finite-distance boundaries produce asymptotic acceleration?

sources.title: Instantons and infinite distances

evidence.text: The hypermultiplet sector provides a setting in which quantum corrections change field-space geometry without lifting the moduli. Its nonperiodic volume and dilaton coordinates permit classical infinite-distance limits.

sources.title: A Distance Conjecture for branes

evidence.text: What quantitative constraints on asymptotically light branes are required for the Sharpened Distance Conjecture to survive compactification, and when does saturation require additional strings, vortices, or non-BPS branes?

sources.title: Refined swampland distance conjecture and exotic hybrid Calabi-Yaus

evidence.text: Do geodesics from exotic finite-distance pseudo-hybrid limits toward large volume satisfy the refined swampland distance conjecture (RSDC), including examples arising from non-abelian GLSMs?

sources.title: Distance and de Sitter Conjectures on the Swampland

evidence.text: What happens to the spectrum when scalar moduli traverse parametrically large proper distances? The conjecture predicts exponentially descending towers, so the low-energy spectrum cannot remain fixed throughout the limit.

sources.title: On the moduli space curvature at infinity

evidence.text: Which type IIA large-volume infinite-distance limits have positive or divergent vector-moduli-space scalar curvature, what geometric and physical sectors cause the divergence, and can this motivate a general quantum-gravity curvature criterion?

sources.title: Instantons and infinite distances

evidence.text: How do instanton corrections change a metric near a classical infinite-distance limit? This comparison studies a restricted IIA hypermultiplet trajectory and its mirror IIB description, including nonperiodic fields and RR kinetic coefficients.

sources.title: End-of-the-World Singularities: The Good, the Bad, and the Heated-up

evidence.text: Which codimension-one singularities reaching infinite scalar-field distance can represent physical End-of-the-World defects, and can near-extremal thermodynamics illuminate the associated Distance Conjecture towers?

sources.title: Moduli space curvature and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: How are gravitational decoupling of rigid field theories, divergent BPS charge-to-mass ratios, and scalar-curvature divergences related, and can curvature characterize a rigid theory's actual cutoff?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Must an equi-dimensional infinite-distance limit of quantum gravity approach a unique weakly coupled string theory, and how is this realized or obstructed in Calabi–Yau three-fold compactifications?

sources.title: Cobordism Classes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can two gravitational backgrounds be joined locally at finite energy, even when their relation by duality requires compactification and an infinite-distance limit?

sources.title: The web of swampland conjectures and the TCC bound

evidence.text: Can numerical relations between distance-conjecture exponents and de Sitter slopes arise from an asymptotic relation between different compactifications and selected field directions?

sources.title: Emergence of Weak Coupling at Large Distance in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: What restrictions does quantum gravity impose on continuous parameters and asymptotic scalar-field geometry? The imported conjectures connect scalar expectation values, infinite moduli-space diameter, and towers becoming exponentially light with geodesic distance.

membershipSample.placementReason: Jointly covers holographic distance limits, light spectra, candidate dual descriptions and curvature/scale questions.

Its associated holographic settings and curvature/duality targets supply the required composite coverage. SCFT distance is not assumed to be gravitational moduli distance.

destinations.title: Do infinite-distance Kähler-moduli limits admit exponentially light physical towers, and can quantum corrections from those towers generate the divergent scalar metric?
These compactifications allow period geometry to determine scalar distances and BPS central charges, providing explicit geometric tests of the distance conjecture.

Which scalar potentials and infinite-distance limits can occur in low-energy theories descending from string theory? The common language is Einstein gravity with scalar field-space metric g_ij, potential V, and geodesic distance D.
How do BPS particles and black-hole extremality behave near infinite distance in a moduli space with several gauge and scalar fields?
Do the endpoints of an unstable flux-vacuum cascade with broken supersymmetry lie at generalized infinite distance, and do KK or emergent-string towers become exponentially light there?

Can Swampland consistency conditions recover the emergent description, gauge-enhancement loci, and nonperturbative brane physics of 9d supergravity limits without assuming a string-theory UV origin, thereby supporting the String Lamppost Principle?

Do warped decompactification limits with a running dilaton satisfy the sharpened Distance Conjecture, the Emergent String Conjecture and the Convex Hull Scalar Weak Gravity Conjecture when non-BPS tower masses vary nontrivially over moduli space?

How are overall-free infinite-distance limits of large-N 4d SCFTs classified by higher-spin decay rates and densities of states, what tensionless strings might describe them, and what do their towers imply for AdS scale separation?

How do approximate axionic shift symmetries and gradients of BPS string tensions and particle masses characterise gravity decoupling, kinetic mixing and curvature divergences in asymptotic moduli-space limits?

destination.title: Gauge dynamics, exact structures and large-N descriptions
destination.question: How do vacuum geometry, gauge observables, global data, compactification and large-N descriptions characterize gauge theories, and which construction or consistency conditions constrain them?
destination.summary: The strongest organizing core concerns four-dimensional supersymmetric gauge theories. The original numerical collection also contains related methods, gravitational effective theories and distinct dimensional settings. These support a connected research family without supplying a common physical premise.

sources.title: Toda Theories, Matrix Models, Topological Strings, and N=2 Gauge Systems

evidence.text: Why should Nekrasov partition functions of four-dimensional N=2 gauge systems correspond to chiral Liouville/Toda blocks, and how can large-N topological-string dualities explain their parameter dictionary and Seiberg–Witten geometry?

sources.title: Classification of large N superconformal gauge theories with a dense spectrum

evidence.text: Which four-dimensional supersymmetric gauge theories with a simple gauge group, no starting superpotential and fixed flavor symmetry admit large-N superconformal limits, and which develop dense chiral spectra or satisfy the tested AdS Weak Gravity Conjecture?

sources.title: Harnessing S-duality in $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 SYM & supergravity as SL(2, ℤ)-averaged strings

evidence.text: What does manifest S-duality imply for finite-N instantons, perturbative analyticity and large-N corrections in N=4 SYM, and how does conformal-manifold averaging relate to its supergravity dual?

sources.title: A Large N duality via a geometric transition

evidence.text: Can a brane-to-flux geometric transition provide a large-N or low-energy dual for four-dimensional N=1 gauge theory with an adjoint and arbitrary polynomial superpotential, yielding exact effective superpotentials and residual abelian gauge couplings?

sources.title: Wilson-'t Hooft operators in four-dimensional gauge theories and S-duality

evidence.text: How should electric–magnetic line operators be classified in four-dimensional gauge theories, how does the conjectured N=4 S-duality group act on them, and what quantitative information is captured by their stress-tensor one-point functions?

sources.title: Monopoles, duality and chiral symmetry breaking in N=2 supersymmetric QCD

evidence.text: Determine the quantum vacuum geometry, low-energy interactions and BPS particle masses of four-dimensional N=2 SU(2) theories with matter, and investigate monopole mechanisms for confinement, chiral symmetry breaking and electric-magnetic duality.

sources.title: Toda Theories, Matrix Models, Topological Strings, and N=2 Gauge Systems

evidence.text: Uses B-brane quantum curves and a Drinfeld–Sokolov connection for the probe derivation. For refinement, evaluates the Gaussian β-ensemble with a Selberg integral and compares its large-N free energy with a hypermultiplet contribution.

sources.title: Classification of large N superconformal gauge theories with a dense spectrum

evidence.text: Fit finite-N numerical central charges and R-charges to large-N trends. Test the AdS WGC using charge-to-dimension ratios; with multiple U(1)s, construct normalized convex polygons or polyhedra and compare their boundary distances with the unit sphere.

sources.title: Harnessing S-duality in $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 SYM & supergravity as SL(2, ℤ)-averaged strings

evidence.text: Introduces an SL(2,Z) Borel transform dividing coefficients by Λ(n+1/2), inverted with a Jacobi-theta kernel. Regularized Poincaré sums and Poisson summation give lattice-integral representations; lateral and median resummation expose D-string corrections.

sources.title: A Large N duality via a geometric transition

evidence.text: Integrating the holomorphic three-form over the sphere fiber reduces its periods to integrals of ω = dx√(W′²+fn−1). Compact periods Si determine deformation coefficients, while regulated noncompact periods Πi = ∂F/∂Si determine special-geometry couplings.

sources.title: Wilson-'t Hooft operators in four-dimensional gauge theories and S-duality

evidence.text: Use monopole quantization, root/coroot lattices and the centralizer of the magnetic weight. The remaining electric source is a representation of the magnetic stabilizer; Weyl stabilizers repackage this information as a simultaneous orbit of two weights.

sources.title: Monopoles, duality and chiral symmetry breaking in N=2 supersymmetric QCD

evidence.text: Constrain curves using anomalous symmetries, semiclassical asymptotics, heavy-flavor decoupling and discriminants. For stable degenerations, the discriminant's vanishing order gives the exponent of the monodromy conjugate to T.

sources.title: SymTFT Fans: The symmetry theory of 4d $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 super Yang-Mills on spaces with boundaries

evidence.text: How do Gaiotto–Witten boundary conditions modify the symmetry theory of 4d N=4 su(N) SYM, particularly its electric/magnetic 1-form symmetries and the transport of operators across boundary-associated sectors?

sources.title: A Strong coupling test of S duality

evidence.text: Can partition functions of topologically twisted N=4 Yang–Mills provide an exact strong-coupling test of Montonen–Olive duality in the vacuum with unbroken nonabelian gauge symmetry, through modular properties of instanton Euler-characteristic generating functions?

sources.title: Exact results on N=2 supersymmetric gauge theories.

evidence.text: Which exact protected quantities illuminate nonperturbative N=2 gauge dynamics, and how can localization, instanton calculus and two-dimensional correspondences test duality conjectures? The article surveys motivations, results and the contents of a special volume.

sources.title: Large N

evidence.text: How does the large-N limit reorganize sigma-model and gauge-theory perturbation theory? The lecture connects topological diagram counting, exact planar enumeration, renormalization-induced divergence, and a procedure for constructing planar amplitudes.

sources.title: Solutions of four-dimensional field theories via M-theory

evidence.text: Can type IIA fourbrane–fivebrane–sixbrane configurations, lifted to M-theory, determine the Coulomb-branch low-energy physics of broad families of four-dimensional N=2 gauge theories with zero or negative beta function?

sources.title: Quantization of Integrable Systems and Four Dimensional Gauge Theories

evidence.text: How does a four-dimensional N=2 gauge theory in a one-parameter Ω-background quantize the classical algebraic integrable system associated with its undeformed Coulomb branch, and determine its quantum spectrum?

sources.title: Families of N=2 field theories.

evidence.text: How do Lagrangian formulations, class S compactifications and Calabi–Yau engineering organize families of four-dimensional N=2 theories, their protected low-energy dynamics and S-dual descriptions? The article presents a reading guide and overview.

sources.title: Disconnected gauge groups in the infrared

evidence.text: How does gauging charge conjugation modify the Seiberg–Witten geometry, Coulomb-branch singularities and massless BPS charges of higher-rank 4d N=2 SU(N) theories?

sources.title: Gauge and gravitational instantons: From 3-forms and fermions to Weak Gravity and flat axion potentials

evidence.text: How do topologically nontrivial gauge configurations generate θ-dependent observables in a four-dimensional Euclidean SU(N) theory? The reviewed construction treats θ as an external source and subsequently introduces Higgs breaking and Dirac matter to control the instanton gas.

sources.title: Reading between the lines of four-dimensional gauge theories

evidence.text: What additional magnetic/dyonic line-operator data specify a four-dimensional gauge theory beyond its Lie algebra and gauge group, and how do these choices affect phases, compactification, discrete θ parameters and supersymmetric dualities?

sources.title: N=2 supersymmetric dynamics for pedestrians

evidence.text: How do supersymmetry, electromagnetic duality and Seiberg–Witten geometry describe four-dimensional N=2 gauge dynamics, including strong-coupling singularities and superconformal limits? These pedagogical lectures reinterpret established results using developments associated with Gaiotto duality.

sources.title: Special Geometry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which formal Abelian N = 2 low-energy Lagrangians arise from quantum-consistent rigid QFTs?

sources.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Tensionless String Limits in 4d SCFTs

evidence.text: What microscopic string backgrounds explain the universality classes of overall weak-coupling, infinite-distance limits of large-N 4d superconformal gauge theories, including theories with non-Einstein holographic duals?

sources.title: Molien function for duality

evidence.text: Can counting holomorphic gauge invariants with Molien functions provide useful information about N=1 gauge theories and duality, particularly when global symmetries give limited constraints?

sources.title: Electric - magnetic duality, monopole condensation, and confinement in N=2 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory

evidence.text: Determine the quantum vacuum geometry, BPS masses and strong-coupling behavior of pure N=2 SU(2) gauge theory, and explain confinement after an N=1 perturbation.

sources.title: Rigid limit in N=2 supergravity and weak-gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can the rigid limit of an N=2 gauge theory embedded in supergravity reveal a new ultraviolet scale proportional to the gauge coupling times the Planck mass?

sources.title: $ \mathcal{N} $ = 2 S-duality revisited

evidence.text: Does the exotic sector in the lowest-rank Argyres-Douglas generalization of Argyres-Seiberg duality factor into interacting and free theories, and can its interacting factor be characterized through protected operators despite the incomplete Seiberg-Witten description?

sources.title: Large N Universality of 4d N=1 SCFTs with Simple Gauge Groups

evidence.text: Which four-dimensional N=1 gauge theories with a simple gauge group admit an interacting large-N SCFT limit with fixed flavor symmetry, and which universal spectral, anomaly and AdS weak-gravity properties characterize them?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: What gauge-theory mechanism explains forced gauge sectors in four and two dimensions, including exceptional-group patterns and tadpole constraints?

sources.title: Geometric engineering, mirror symmetry and $ 6{\mathrm{d}}_{\left(1,0\right)}\to 4{\mathrm{d}}_{\left(\mathcal{N}=2\right)} $

evidence.text: Which 4d N=2 SCFTs arise from toroidal compactification of 6d (1,0) theories, and how do choices of limiting point and flavor Wilson lines determine their vacuum geometry, flavor symmetry and dualities?
